result.description:
Located in the charming town of Warwick, Cafe 63 Warwick stands as a cherished dining haven, renowned for its warm ambiance and dedication to exceptional culinary experiences. Our menus are thoughtfully designed to highlight innovative dishes made from the freshest local produce. At Cafe 63, we celebrate a rich culinary tradition and a commitment to quality, ensuring a memorable experience for every visitor.

Location: Warwick, QLD

Position: Chef

Responsibilities:
•	Menu Planning and Cost Management: Develop and refine menus while managing food and labour costs. Collaborate with suppliers to ensure quality ingredients and efficient provisioning.
•	Quality Control: Oversee every stage of dish preparation, from initial concept to final presentation, ensuring each plate meets our high standards.
•	Team Collaboration: Work closely with management and staff, including kitchen and waitstaff, to discuss and resolve any food preparation or service issues.
•	Skill Enhancement: Lead by example, demonstrating culinary techniques and offering guidance on cooking procedures to kitchen staff.
•	Food Preparation: Hands-on preparation and cooking of food, ensuring each dish is executed with precision.
•	Hygiene and Safety: Uphold and advocate strict hygiene and safety regulations to maintain a safe and clean kitchen environment.
•	Staff Development: Participate in the selection and training of new kitchen staff, fostering a learning environment that encourages growth and excellence.
•	Innovation: Continuously innovate in food preservation and presentation techniques to enhance the dining experience.

Personal Attributes:
•	Creative and innovative thinking in menu design and food presentation.
•	Strong leadership and communication skills, capable of motivating and instructing kitchen staff.
•	Commitment to maintaining high standards of cleanliness and organization.
•	A passion for culinary arts with a desire to continually learn and improve skills.

Qualifications:
•	At least 1 year of experience in a professional kitchen.
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma, or Diploma in Culinary Arts or a related field.

Salary: $70,000 - $80,000 plus superannuation per annum

Type: Full-time (38 hours per week)

If you are driven by a passion for culinary innovation and strive for excellence in every dish, please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your experience and culinary philosophy.

Join us to shape the future of dining in Warwick at Cafe 63, where your culinary skills will be cherished and nurtured.
result.title: Chef

result.description:
About Us

Established in 1946, Teys Australia is a beef processing and food production business. We are best known for providing quality Aussie beef to customers here in Australia and around the world. 

With operations across 14 locations in Qld, NSW, Victoria, and South Australia, we are the second largest beef processor and exporter in Australia, employing over 5000 passionate people who drive our success, and bring their very best to work every day. 

Together, we focus on feeding people and enriching lives. Join us!

About the Role

Teys Australia is seeking an experienced Maintenance Electrician to join the Maintenance team based at our Tamworth processing site in New South Wales. The role?will be responsible for: 

Fault finding intricate meat processing machines
Carry out planned, preventative and reactive maintenance
Assist in the identification and elimination of bottle necks
Respond efficiently to breakdown conditions to minimise equipment/production downtime
About You

You must have the following experience/skills:

Electrical trade qualification
Knowledge of Instrumentation
Excellent communications and technical skills
Ability to develop circuit drawings and read circuit drawings
Fault finding experience with VSDs & PLCs
Switchboard building experience (desirable)
PLC and HMI programming experience (desirable)
Fire systems experience (desirable)
Current drivers licence.

What’s in it for You

Attractive hourly rate starting from $50.23 to $66.30.
Access to a variety of discounts: meat products, health insurance and retailers
Service recognition awards 
Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counselling services for you and your family
Opportunities to upskill and advance your career in meat production, maintenance, or management roles.
To Apply

If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment within a growing business offering excellent career development and opportunities, we encourage you to APPLY today. 

For a confidential discussion about this role, please phone Taylah on 0447 446 010. 

You can check us out at www.teysgroup.com.au or join us on https://www.facebook.com/TeysAustralia.
